svg.aria-label: Start C4 + E4, end C4 + F4. The lower voice holds C4. The upper voice moves from E4 to F4. Oblique motion: one voice holds while the other moves.
svg.title: Change 1: only the upper voice rises

g.text: How to read this graphic: The dashed square is where the upper voice began, on E4, and
the arrow takes it to F4. The circle on C4 does not move. The page does not yet say what
pair this makes; you will name it later, from the same picture.
